title: Zoology: Human Diseases Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of pathogens, deficiency diseases, and emerging viruses.

questions.question: Which of the following is the causative agent of Tuberculosis?
African sleeping sickness is transmitted by which vector?
Deficiency of Vitamin D (Calciferol) leads to which of the following diseases?
Which instrument is used to measure blood pressure?
Hypermetropia (far-sightedness) is corrected using which type of lens?
The National Malaria Eradication Programme (NMEP) aims to stamp out Malaria. What is the causative agent of Malaria?
In which year was the State AIDS cell established in Tamil Nadu?
Which emerging virus is known to cause microcephaly in infants if the mother is infected during pregnancy?
The Ebola Virus outbreak (2013-2015) primarily affected which region?
Ergotism (listed as 'Drug' disease in the text) is caused by which fungal agent?
Which protein deficiency disease is characterized by thin muscles but a bulgy face and stomach?
Swine Influenza Virus (SIV) caused a major outbreak in India in which year?
Under the National Immunisation Programme, the MMR vaccine is recommended between which ages?
Which of the following diseases is caused by a defect in blood coagulation due to Vitamin K deficiency?
